integrity: Original source models and the already catalogued scalar sequence are acknowledged; analytic arguments and independent finite checks are distinguished. No claim of independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact statements apply only to full capacity-one DP-Nash subgraphs on labeled paths and simple cycles; not a count of D-sets, nonspecialized equilibria or their strategic realization. Previously known star-factor reduction and OEIS scalar sequence acknowledged. Uniform equilibrium selection is a counting convention. Independent priority and scientific audit remain outstanding.
title: Exact provider spectra and a Gaussian law for capacity-one public-goods equilibria on paths and rings
